messages.label: POST turn (mid, text, attachments)
messages.note: Attachments stay on the waiter in memory only

messages.label: receiveInbound: insert once by chat and mid
messages.note: Repeat: answered returns the stored reply, dropped returns empty, running waits then rereads

messages.label: enqueue waiter (command flag splits batch)
messages.note: Command-shaped text anywhere runs alone; the batch splits before and after it

messages.label: timer fires: start batch
messages.note: Each message resets the timer, capped at three batchMs; a turn after a running turn starts at once

messages.label: openTurn plus claimPending up to newest mid
messages.note: Claims unanswered rows and reclaims interrupted rows; later rows wait

messages.label: execute: resolve, admit, run, clean
messages.note: Resolve checks chat and pack; admit checks sender, delivery, spend; one direct command skips the loop

messages.label: closeTurn: store reply, close record
messages.note: One transaction; the reply is stored once as the assistant row

messages.label: TurnReply for newest; empty for merged others
messages.note: A repeat of a merged message gets empty; NO_REPLY sends nothing
